import importlib.util

mods = [
    "pypdf", "PyPDF2", "reportlab", "pdf2image", "PIL", "fitz",
    "fpdf", "weasyprint", "img2pdf", "pikepdf", "pandas", "numpy",
]
for m in mods:
    spec = importlib.util.find_spec(m)
    print(f"{m}: {'AVAILABLE' if spec else 'missing'}")

import shutil

tools = [
    "qpdf", "pdftk", "pdftotext", "pdfunite", "pdfseparate", "gs", "mutool",
    "convert", "magick", "img2pdf", "python3", "pip", "pip3",
]
for t in tools:
    path = shutil.which(t)
    print(f"{t}: {path if path else 'missing'}")

import os
import sys
import site
import glob

print("sys.executable:", sys.executable)
print("sys.version:", sys.version)
print("sys.path:")
for p in sys.path:
    print("  ", p)
print("site.getsitepackages():", site.getsitepackages())

venv_sp = glob.glob("/mlx_devbox/users/zhengxinran/playground/code_zxr/agent_safety/benchmarks/external/MSB/.venv/lib/python*/site-packages")
print("MSB venv site-packages:", venv_sp)
for sp in venv_sp:
    if os.path.isdir(sp):
        names = sorted(os.listdir(sp))
        interesting = [n for n in names if any(k in n.lower() for k in
                       ["pypdf", "pdf2", "reportlab", "pil", "fitz", "fpdf", "weasy", "img2pdf", "pikepdf", "poppler"])]
        print(f"{sp} interesting entries:", interesting)

import os

print("CWD:", os.getcwd())
for name in sorted(os.listdir(".")):
    full = os.path.join(".", name)
    if os.path.isfile(full):
        with open(full, "rb") as f:
            head = f.read(16)
        print(f"{name}\t{os.path.getsize(full)} bytes\thead={head!r}")

pdf = "report.pdf"
if os.path.isfile(pdf):
    with open(pdf, "rb") as f:
        data = f.read()
    print(f"\n{pdf}: {len(data)} bytes")
    print("header:", data[:32])
    print("tail:", data[-64:])
    print("eof marker present:", data.rstrip().endswith(b"%%EOF"))
else:
    print(f"\n{pdf} NOT FOUND")
